A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EchoVLA/MoMani research. All 18 pages of v2 and 19 pages of v3 were inspected, with readable text, equations, figures and tables. Neither supplied PDF contains a separate appendix.

before.justification: Sections 5.2–5.4 and Tables 2–5 report original simulation evaluations, component ablations, sensitivity tests and real-robot success rates.

after.justification: v3 retains the original simulation, ablation, sensitivity and real-robot results in Sections 5.2–5.4 and Tables 2–5.

M1.justification: The encoders, dual memories, attention fusion and per-part diffusion objective are retained. Section 3.3 specifies spatial indexing, local retrieval and EMA updating more explicitly, but v2's less detailed description does not establish that the underlying procedure changed; these are documented implementation refinements.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four RoboCasa tasks, navigation-only coverage, mobile manipulation variants and six real-robot tasks, including cross-room EnP. The expanded dataset description introduces no additional evaluated domain or scenario.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains BC-T, Diffusion Policy, DP3, WB-VIMA and π0.5 for manipulation/navigation, and the same comparator subset excluding Diffusion Policy for mobile manipulation. Table 5 retains π0.5 and Diffusion Policy as real-robot comparators.

E3.justification: Dataset sizes, task variants, success-rate metrics, 50-episode simulation evaluations, 50-episode ablations and 20-trial real-robot evaluations are unchanged. Newly specified memory implementation details do not establish revised experimental settings.

E4.justification: The modality and memory ablations in Table 3, window-size and threshold sweeps in Table 4, rollouts in Figure 6, and perceptual-noise and dynamic-occlusion analyses in Section 5.4 are retained. Their relocation and caption edits add no new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging simulation results over three random seeds and conducting 20 independent real-robot trials per task. Neither adds confidence intervals, dispersion estimates or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Section 5.2 corrects π0.5's stated success-rate decline from 0.47→0.36 to 0.32→0.20, matching Table 2 in both versions. Section 5.4 changes the reported EnP length from 362.0 to 362.9 frames. Numerical results in Tables 2–5 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: v3 adds explicit definitions of squared reconstruction error and the EMA scene-memory update in Equations 3–4, where v2 described discrepancy-based updating qualitatively. Other mathematical formulations are retained, with no new theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same dual-memory contribution, MoMani benchmark contribution and performance claims. The rewritten conclusion emphasizes previously discussed perceptual-noise mitigation without materially changing the central claims.

C2.justification: Section 6 newly identifies cold-start difficulty when scene memory is sparse in novel environments, proposing exploration or generative 3D priors as future remedies. It also adds alternative encoders as future work. Existing odometry-drift and dynamic-occlusion limitations remain.

D1.justification: Section 3.3 newly specifies spatial key/value storage, camera-frustum retrieval, an MLP reconstruction decoder and EMA coefficient α=0.2. The threshold τ=0.5 was already reported in v2's sensitivity study. v3 also omits v2's explicit paragraph describing continued memory updating during inference.

R1.justification: Related-work positioning is unchanged. v3 adds a journal entry for Diffusion Policy, already cited as a preprint in v2, rather than a distinct research work. Reference renumbering and added access dates are bibliographic edits.

P1.justification: v3 revises the title and author information, adds acknowledgements, condenses Section 3.2, and rewrites parts of Sections 3.3, 4.3 and 6 while preserving the section structure. It introduces an unresolved 'Sec. ??' reference where v2 correctly referenced Section 3.2.

P2.justification: The same six figures and five tables remain, with wider page margins and revised float placement. Figures 3–4 and Table 4 change from wrapped displays to wider standalone displays. Several captions are shortened or clarified, including explicit Mobile/Static definitions in Table 3.

improvement.justification: v3 corrects the π0.5 prose/Table 2 inconsistency, provides more explicit scene-memory specifications and acknowledges the cold-start limitation, improving precision and reproducibility. These limited gains outweigh the new unresolved section reference and loss of explicit inference-update documentation. The empirical evidence remains essentially unchanged.
